outline: 本課程目標在提供學生英漢與漢英口譯專業訓練。課程內容含括專業逐步與同步口譯技巧，以及口譯過程與訓練的學術理論。重點將置於重述、記憶訓練、數字與語法轉換、筆記與跟述練習，以累積逐步與同步口譯技巧。
schedule:
WEEK	SESSION THEME
1	Introduction
2     	Break
3     	Introduction to interpreting: Theory and Practice
4     	Public speaking and paraphrasing I
5    	Break
6	Paraphrasing II
7	Sight translation (ST)
8   	ST
9    	Mid-term
10    	ST
11    	Pre Exercise: Memory exercises (Hearing- Listening- Analysing- memorising)
12   	Short consecutive interpreting (CI)
13   	Note-taking skills for CI I
14   	Note-taking Skills for CI II
15   	Note-taking Skills for CI III
16   	Note-taking Skills for CI IV
17   	Wrap-up (ST/CI)
18   	Final
assessment:
Assessment
	30% on mid-term examination
	30% on final examination
	40% on continual assessments: attendance to lectures; presentations; in-class performance; homework recording and researching
